raw_dataset_statistics.raw_status_formatting_issues: Contains casing/whitespace variants ('delivered', 'Rto', 'RTO ') normalized via str.strip().str.upper().

data_cleaning_and_deduplication.reconciliation_rationale: All 30 duplicate order IDs were verified to be 100% exact row replicas (identical timestamps, customer details, addresses, and order outcomes). None represented conflicting states. Dropping the 30 duplicates produces 1,988 distinct customer transactions.

in_transit_exclusion_policy.rationale: Single unresolved order (IN_TRANSIT) does not have a definitive terminal outcome (DELIVERED or RTO). Including censored/indeterminate states introduces label noise during binary classification training.

chronological_split.strategy: Strict Temporal Holdout (April-July 2026 Train, August-September 2026 Test)
chronological_split.rationale: Avoids future-data leakage; simulates real-world production deployment where the model trained on historical data predicts future incoming orders.
